concepts.meaning: Caller-reported terminal call observation tied to one declared Workflow occurrence and exact action.
Ordered committed occurrences, never a deduplicated Operation set or an arbitrary completion set.
Argument preparation failed before the next Operation was called, distinct from a returned Operation failure.
A committed call and a usable typed result are separate facts; later result failure cannot erase committed effects.
Forward step failure may enter the selected recovery policy; post-commit local result errors are explicit not-evaluable diagnostics outside that policy.

distinctions: caller observation versus authenticated provider evidence
diagnostic policy gap versus recovery not-required
